steps.name: scope
steps.description: Clarify the research question and success criteria using the task and existing evidence. Make reasonable assumptions explicit. Ask only for information necessary to resolve a meaningful ambiguity; a missing file list is not a blocker. Record the scope for subsequent stages.

steps.name: gather
steps.description: Gather relevant primary sources, repository evidence and existing project knowledge. Record source links and findings for the next stage. Respect authentication and data-access boundaries; do not modify unrelated implementation code.

steps.name: synthesize
steps.description: Combine the gathered evidence into findings, trade-offs and recommendations. Distinguish facts from inference, flag unresolved questions, and describe actionable next steps only when supported. Record a synthesis artifact for the documentation stage.

steps.name: document
steps.description: Write the requested research artifact from the synthesis, with supporting sources, assumptions and unresolved questions. Validate the artifact in an appropriate way and record its location and useful follow-up work. Keep edits related to the requested documentation.
